title: Onion Router
story: We intercepted a highly secure message from the snack committee.
They used multiple layers of encryption.
First it was Base64 encoded, and then ROT13 encrypted.
Or was it the other way around? Just figure it out.
objective: Decode the message in message.txt and submit the secret.
hints: Try chaining commands with pipes. e.g. cat file | base64 decode | rot13
